register.title: Bikri dukan ki darkhwast
register.subtitle: Apni dukan ke bare mein batayein. Dukan banane se pehle hum har darkhwast ka jaiza lete hain.
register.intro: Darkhwast bhejne ke baad hum jaiza lenge. Agar ibtidai jaiza pass ho to hum Cloudflare se is email par verification email bhejwayenge. Us email mein link par click karein; registration code sirf email verification aur darkhwast ki approval ke baad jari hoga. Email Cloudflare se aayegi, Bikri se nahi.
register.privacy: Hum ye tafseelat sirf darkhwast ke jaize aur aap se rabte ke liye use karte hain. Kisi aur ki email darj na karein.
register.success_body: Hum pehle jaiza lenge. Agar munasib ho to Cloudflare ki email dekhein aur verification link par click karein. Aap ka registration code abhi jari nahi hua.
register.error_rate: Bohat zyada darkhwastein. Ek minute baad koshish karein.
register.error_generic: Darkhwast nahi bhej saki. Dobara koshish karein.
register.status_awaiting_email: Apni email dekhein — Cloudflare verification bhej di
register.status_approved: Manzoor — aap ka registration code email/WhatsApp par bhej diya gaya
register.status_missing_body: Darkhwast ki tasdeeq wala halat link kholen.
register.status_error_body: Thori der baad dobara koshish karein.
